onboarding.aboutInfo: Your contacts will have names common in your country and speak your preferred language. Contacts in every style are adults, usually within two years of your age, with a minimum age of 18. Gender does not determine your contacts’ personalities. Friends have varied interests. Study and work teams use your field to create complementary contacts.
onboarding.consent: I agree to enable shared memory for my five AI contacts. If I create a group, its members can read the full group history. Facts shared in private or group chats may become shared memories recalled by these contacts in other chats; private transcripts remain access controlled. Setup uses Meta Standard processing.

onboarding.canClose: You can close the app. Your circle will keep taking shape.
onboarding.failed: We could not finish your circle. Retry to continue with your saved preferences and portraits.

sharing.contactDisclosure1: Start your own empty chat with this contact. Its memories and presence are shared with other participants. Your schedules and notifications belong to you.
sharing.contactDisclosure2: The contact can share remembered facts about you with other participants. Your original messages and attachments are private. You can keep your chat private in the contact’s details. The creator can remove your access.
sharing.contactContributorNote: Messages and shared memories sent to Meta may be used to train its models.

join.title: Join Shared Contact
join.help: Paste the code you received from the contact's creator.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.groupDisclosure: Group members can see your name and profile photo. Members can read the group's history, including messages sent before they joined, unless they were added without earlier messages. Contacts use what group members have told them, except chats kept private. What you say here can become a shared memory, used in this group and in private chats with its members, never in other groups. Leaving stops access to your contributed group memories; messages remain visible in the group until it is deleted.
invitations.groupDisclosureWithoutHistory: Group members can see your name and profile photo. You'll see messages from when you join. Contacts use what group members have told them, except chats kept private. What you say here can become a shared memory, used in this group and in private chats with its members, never in other groups. Leaving stops access to your contributed group memories; messages remain visible in the group until it is deleted.
invitations.groupContributorNote: This installation uses Meta's Contributor model. Group messages and shared memories sent to Meta may be used for model training.
